caption: The drawing features a rectangular wooden cabinet standing on four tapered legs. The cabinet is divided horizontally into two sections, each with a flat front surface. The surface of the cabinet is decorated with a repeating floral or leafy pattern rendered in muted tones of olive green, brown, and hints of red or pink. The edges and corners of the cabinet are defined with thin, darker lines, and the top, bottom, and side edges of the cabinet have slightly protruding moldings. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or details present. The artist’s signature appears in the lower left corner of the image.
title: Chest with Drawer
